what: `--brainstorm` can still pair with a tier-gate-selected trivial tier
scenario_or_breakage: When argv has `--brainstorm` but no tier flag, Step 0b still offers `trivial`; choosing it writes `brainstorm_requested=true` with `sketch_budget=0`, bypassing the proposed `--trivial` + `--brainstorm` mutex.
suggested_fix: When `brainstorm_requested=true`, remove `trivial` from the tier gate or run the same Upgrade-to-simple / Cancel prompt after a trivial tier-gate choice before writing run-params.

what: Prompt token file is not load-bound for Step 1d.5
scenario_or_breakage: The plan creates `brainstorm-prompts.md` but the Step 1d.5 insertion only mandates reading `brainstorm.md`; executors can render prompt files with unresolved `<BRAINSTORM_*_PROMPT>` tokens.
suggested_fix: Add a mandatory read of `skills/design/references/brainstorm-prompts.md` before prompt rendering, either in SKILL.md Step 1d.5 or as the first nested directive inside `brainstorm.md`, mirroring the sketch-prompts/sketch-launch contract.

scenario_or_breakage: Step 1d can short-circuit on straightforward features before writing any decisions file; a planned concatenation of `feature-description.txt + discussion-round1.md` can fail or produce a noisy warning in the common no-discussion path.
suggested_fix: Define FEATURE_DESCRIPTION as `feature-description.txt` plus `discussion-round1.md` only when the latter exists and is non-empty.

what: New brainstorm prompt harness is not wired into lint
scenario_or_breakage: The plan adds `skills/design/scripts/test-brainstorm-prompts.sh` but does not add a Makefile target or shard entry, so `make lint` will not run it; adding only a target later without a shard will trip the shard-coverage harness.
suggested_fix: Add `test-brainstorm-prompts` to `.PHONY`, add a target invoking the script through `scripts/harness-timer.sh`, and append it to one `test-harnesses-N` shard.

what: `run-params.json` schema docs are omitted from the schema change
scenario_or_breakage: The plan adds `brainstorm_requested` to `write-run-params.sh` but leaves the sibling contract documenting only `partition_requested`, despite its explicit edit-in-sync rule for schema changes.
suggested_fix: Update `scripts/write-run-params.md` with the new optional flag, emitted JSON field, default false behavior, and harness coverage.
